name: Rajasthan
primary_causes: Aridity and hyper-arid climate in Thar Desert
Overgrazing by high livestock density
Depletion of deep fossil groundwater
Wind deflation of active sand dunes
environmental_impact: Accelerated sand dune migration towards canal command areas; loss of indigenous scrub ecosystems; recurring severe droughts.
prevention_measures: Shelterbelt plantations using Prosopis cineraria (Khejri) and Acacia tortilis; sand dune stabilization with micro-windbreaks; pressurized drip irrigation along Indira Gandhi Canal; silvopastoral grazing management.
active_schemes: Green Wall of India Project (Aravalli Range)
data_source: ISRO Space Applications Centre (SAC) Desertification Atlas 2021
methodology: IRS AWiFS satellite remote sensing, ground truth verification by CAZRI Jodhpur

name: Maharashtra
primary_causes: Monoculture of water-intensive cash crops (sugarcane) in rain-shadow regions
Over-irrigation in heavy black cotton soils causing secondary salinization
Soil loss on undulating Deccan Plateau
environmental_impact: Severe groundwater table drawdown in Marathwada and Vidarbha; topsoil nutrient exhaustion; agrarian vulnerability.
prevention_measures: Broad-bed furrow cultivation; continuous contour trenching (CCT); watershed treatment via ridge-to-valley approach; farm ponds; sub-surface drainage in canal commands.
data_source: ISRO Space Applications Centre (SAC) Desertification Atlas 2021
methodology: Multi-spectral IRS AWiFS & Landsat OLI classification, NRSC ground validation

name: Gujarat
primary_causes: Seawater ingress along 1,600 km coastline
Hyper-saline conditions in Rann of Kachchh and Banni grasslands
Over-extraction of coastal aquifers
environmental_impact: Inland advance of salinity; destruction of native Banni grass taxa; freshwater well turning brackish.
prevention_measures: Tidal regulators and bandharas along coastline; Prosopis juliflora eradication replaced with indigenous Salvadora and Acacia; halophyte plantation; laser land leveling.
data_source: ISRO SAC Desertification & Land Degradation Atlas 2021
methodology: Remote sensing thermal/optical multi-temporal satellite data

name: Karnataka
primary_causes: Dryland drought vulnerability across northern Karnataka (Deccan trap)
Topsoil runoff during erratic monsoons
Canal command waterlogging and salinization in Tungabhadra and Upper Krishna basin
environmental_impact: Siltation of major reservoirs; severe summer moisture deficit; crop yield drop in semi-arid pulse belt.
prevention_measures: Sujala watershed development models; contour bunding; horticulture integration with dryland crops (tamarind, amla); tank desilting.
data_source: ISRO SAC Atlas 2021 / Karnataka State Remote Sensing Applications Centre (KSRSAC)
methodology: IRS LISS-IV & AWiFS composite classification

name: Madhya Pradesh
primary_causes: Severe gully erosion forming Chambal badlands / ravines
Deforestation on fragile forest fringes
Overgrazing and opencast coal/iron mining in Singrauli & Jabalpur
environmental_impact: Loss of agricultural acreage to advancing ravine heads; topsoil transport into Yamuna river system.
prevention_measures: Ravine reclamation using bamboo plantation and vegetative check dams; aerial seeding of degraded forest patches; participatory forest management.
active_schemes: Chambal Ravine Reclamation Project (with World Bank)
methodology: IRS AWiFS satellite analysis & Survey of India topographic sheets

name: Odisha
primary_causes: Shifting cultivation (Podu chasa) in southern tribal highlands
High-intensity coastal cyclones causing coastal erosion and sea surge
Extensive iron-ore, bauxite and chromite mining in Keonjhar and Sukinda
environmental_impact: Heavy metal runoff; mangrove loss along coastline; siltation of Chilika lagoon and Hirakud reservoir.
prevention_measures: Transition from Podu to settled agroforestry (cashew, coffee, mango); mangrove belt restoration along Kendrapara coast; mine dump stabilization with geotextiles.
active_schemes: Odisha Forestry Sector Development Project (OFSDP - JICA)
data_source: ISRO SAC Desertification Atlas 2021 / Odisha Space Applications Centre (ORSAC)
methodology: High-resolution satellite mapping and ground truth calibration

name: Andhra Pradesh
primary_causes: Aridity and recurring drought in Rayalaseema districts (Ananthapuramu)
Heavy topsoil sheet wash in Eastern Ghats
Coastal aquaculture runoff causing localized salinity
environmental_impact: Desertification risk in Ananthapuramu; groundwater depletion; loss of red soil top layer.
prevention_measures: Andhra Pradesh Community-managed Natural Farming (APCNF); percolation tanks; bio-fencing and zero tillage practices.
methodology: IRS AWiFS LISS-III imagery, state ground inventory

name: Telangana
primary_causes: Dry deciduous scrub degradation in semi-arid zones
Monoculture of Bt cotton on rainfed red chalka soils
Over-reliance on borewell irrigation in granitic terrain
environmental_impact: Rapid groundwater table drawdown; localized soil hardening and crusting.
prevention_measures: Massive revival of historic irrigation cascades (chain tanks); Telanganaku Haritha Haram mass afforestation; subsoiling to break hardpan.
data_source: ISRO SAC Desertification Atlas 2021 / TRAC Telangana
methodology: Digital image processing of Sentinel-2 & IRS AWiFS

name: Uttar Pradesh
primary_causes: Geogenic sodium accumulation creating hard sodic Usar crusts in central alluvium
Flat gradient and poor canal drainage leading to waterlogging
Sheet and gully erosion in Bundelkhand rocky terrain
environmental_impact: Unproductive vast patches of white alkali land; seasonal inundation destroying Kharif crops in Terai belt.
prevention_measures: Chemical reclamation with mineral gypsum and press-mud; salt-tolerant varieties (CSR 30 rice, KRL 210 wheat); drainage interceptors; Bundelkhand farm pond missions.
active_schemes: UP Sodic Land Reclamation Project (UPSLRP III - World Bank)
Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Kisan Samriddhi Yojana
data_source: ISRO SAC Desertification Atlas 2021 / Remote Sensing Applications Centre UP (RSAC-UP)
methodology: IRS AWiFS satellite sensors + Ground sampling by CSSRI Karnal

name: Jharkhand
primary_causes: Open-cast coal, iron, and mica mining leaving vast abandoned overburden dumps
Severe rill and sheet erosion on Chota Nagpur Plateau undulating slopes
Degradation of Sal (Shorea robusta) forests
environmental_impact: Acid mine drainage; flash runoff and rapid topsoil loss; drying of natural springs (dari/chuha).
prevention_measures: Gradonies and staggered contour trenches on plateau slopes; biological reclamation of mine dumps using vetiver grass and leguminous tree species; 5% model farm ponds (Doba).
methodology: AWiFS multi-date data validated by JSAC Ranchi

name: Bihar
primary_causes: Recurring flood inundation in Kosi, Gandak and Bagmati river basins
Topsoil deposition of coarse unproductive flood sand
Water stagnation in saucer-shaped chaurs and tals
environmental_impact: Loss of prime cropland during monsoon; sand-casting rendering fields uncultivable for multiple seasons.
prevention_measures: Drainage syphon construction; integration of aquaculture and fox nut (Makhana) in permanent wetlands; sand-casting reclamation by silt enrichment.
active_schemes: Bihar Kosi Basin Development Project (World Bank)
methodology: Optical & SAR (Sentinel-1) flood and waterlogging temporal mapping

name: West Bengal
primary_causes: Cyclone breaches of coastal mud embankments flooding paddy fields with seawater
Lateritic soil erosion in Purulia and Bankura drylands
Riverbank collapse along Bhagirathi-Hooghly
environmental_impact: Acute soil salinity poisoning deltaic freshwater agriculture; mangrove habitat squeeze.
prevention_measures: Geo-tube reinforced embankment construction; mangrove afforestation along tidal edges; salt-tolerant indigenous rice varieties (Pokkali, Hamilton).
data_source: ISRO SAC Atlas 2021 / West Bengal State Council of Science & Technology
methodology: Remote sensing coastal and deltaic change detection

name: Tamil Nadu
primary_causes: Soil erosion in Nilgiris and Palani hills due to plantation slopes
Over-exploitation of hard-rock groundwater aquifers
Coastal salinity intrusion in Cauvery Delta
environmental_impact: Drop in soil moisture retention; hill landslides in tea estate slopes during torrential northeast monsoons.
prevention_measures: Bench terracing on tea and coffee estates; check dam networks; community tank rehabilitation (Kudimaramath); Vetiver hedgerows for slope stabilization.
active_schemes: Tamil Nadu Irrigated Agriculture Modernization Project (TNIAMP)
methodology: Multi-spectral IRS AWiFS analysis

name: Punjab
severity: Low by Area, Critical by Agronomic Intensity
primary_causes: Paddy-wheat mono-cropping rotation causing catastrophic groundwater drawdown and nutrient mining
Canal seepage and rising saline water table in Muktsar, Fazilka, and Bathinda
Intensive pesticide and chemical fertilizer application
environmental_impact: Subsurface soil compaction (hard plow pan); loss of microbial life; waterlogging rendering fertile farmland unproductive.
prevention_measures: Direct Seeded Rice (DSR) technique; sub-surface drainage systems to flush out salts; crop diversification into maize, pulses and oilseeds; laser land leveling.
active_schemes: Promotion of Agricultural Mechanization for In-Situ Management of Crop Residue
data_source: ISRO SAC Desertification Atlas 2021 / Punjab Remote Sensing Centre (PRSC)
methodology: IRS LISS-III & LISS-IV geospatial time-series

name: Haryana
primary_causes: Inland basin geometry with no natural drainage outlet leading to rising saline water tables in Rohtak, Jhajjar, and Hisar
Wind drift along the Rajasthan border in Mahendragarh and Bhiwani
Intensive multi-cropping.
environmental_impact: Crop root zone salinization; loss of soil structure; alkaline crust formation.
prevention_measures: Sub-surface drainage (SSD) technology installed by ICAR-CSSRI; micro-sprinkler systems; solar water-lifting pumps; green manuring with Sesbania (Dhaincha).
methodology: Remote sensing coupled with CSSRI soil profile survey data

name: Himachal Pradesh
primary_causes: Glacial retreat, permafrost thaw and freeze-thaw rock shattering in Lahaul-Spiti and Kinnaur
Cloudbursts and high-intensity rainfall triggering flash landslides
Road construction debris disposal on unstable slopes
environmental_impact: River course obstruction; debris torrents; loss of alpine meadow topsoil.
prevention_measures: Bio-engineering slope stabilization using crib walls and native alder/poplar; check dam cascades; cold desert seabuckthorn (Hippophae rhamnoides) plantation.
active_schemes: HP Forest Eco-systems Climate Proofing Project (KFW)
Integrated Development Project for Source Sustainability and Climate Resilient Rain-fed Agriculture
methodology: Cryospheric & high altitude multi-temporal satellite analysis

name: Uttarakhand
primary_causes: Tectonic fragility of the Main Central Thrust and Main Boundary Thrust
Heavy torrential monsoons causing gully formation and slope collapse
Forest fires during dry pre-monsoon months damaging ground litter
environmental_impact: Silt choked hydroelectric turbines in Alaknanda and Bhagirathi; highway blockages; drying of natural mountain springs (Dharas).
prevention_measures: Springshed management (Dhara Vikas); check dam construction; geogrid slope revetment; Oak forest conservation for water retention.
methodology: Optical multi-spectral & Cartosat DEM topographic terrain modeling

name: Jammu & Kashmir
primary_causes: Karewa sediment mining and slope excavation
Deforestation in Pir Panjal range
High-energy water runoff during spring snowmelt
environmental_impact: Siltation of Wular and Dal lakes; loss of saffron-growing fertile Karewa soils.
prevention_measures: Strict moratorium on illegal Karewa mining; catchment afforestation; terraced orchard management.
methodology: High-resolution satellite mapping

name: Ladakh

dominant_processes.type: Frost Shattering & Cold Desert Bare Soil

primary_causes: Extremely arid climate with annual precipitation < 100 mm
High solar ultraviolet radiation degrading organic matter
Rapid permafrost thaw due to warming climate
environmental_impact: Spring water scarcity for traditional agrarian villages; barren gravel moraines with no natural soil regeneration.
prevention_measures: Artificial ice stupas / artificial glaciers for springtime irrigation meltwater; seabuckthorn planting along stream banks; trench composting.
methodology: Satellite cryospheric and geomorphic classification

name: Assam
primary_causes: Severe braided channel migration and riverbank erosion along the Brahmaputra and Barak rivers
Annual catastrophic monsoon flooding carrying coarse silt
Shifting cultivation on Karbi Anglong and Dima Hasao hill slopes
environmental_impact: Displacement of riverine island (Char) communities; permanent loss of fertile agricultural acreage into riverbed.
prevention_measures: Porcupine and geotextile revetment along vulnerable river banks; vetiver bio-fencing on dykes; agroforestry on elevated platforms.
active_schemes: Chief Minister's Samagra Gramya Unnayan Yojana
Assam Project on Forest and Biodiversity Conservation (APFBC)
data_source: ISRO SAC Desertification Atlas 2021 / Assam Remote Sensing Application Centre (ARSAC)
methodology: Satellite radar (RISAT-1/Sentinel-1) flood and multi-spectral erosion mapping

name: Nagaland
primary_causes: Shortening of traditional Jhum (slash-and-burn) cycle from 15-20 years to 3-5 years due to population pressure
Steep slope deforestation causing massive topsoil runoff during monsoons.
environmental_impact: Exhaustion of organic soil fertility; recurring village landslides; drying up of downhill headwaters.
prevention_measures: Agro-forestry based settled farming with nitrogen-fixing Alder trees (Alnus nepalensis); terrace cultivation; Community Conserved Areas (CCAs).
methodology: AWiFS multi-temporal jhum tracking

name: Mizoram
primary_causes: Shifting slash-and-burn cultivation on fragile shale and sandstone slopes
Bamboo gregarious flowering and subsequent soil exposure during die-back.
environmental_impact: Accelerated hill-slope sheet wash; siltation of perennial river valleys.
prevention_measures: New Land Use Policy (NLUP) promoting permanent horticulture (passion fruit, dragon fruit, rubber); contour bunding; community reserve forests.
methodology: Satellite remote sensing terrain time-series

name: Meghalaya
primary_causes: Unscientific rat-hole coal and limestone mining releasing toxic acidic leachate
Intense rainfall (highest in the world at Mawsynram/Sohra) stripping exposed soil on deforested plateau slopes.
environmental_impact: Acidification of rivers (Lukha river turning bright blue due to sulfate precipitates); barren limestone karst.
prevention_measures: Phytoremediation with acid-tolerant reeds and biochar; strict regulation of artisanal mining; bamboo drip irrigation systems.
active_schemes: Meghalaya Community Led Landscapes Management Project (CLLMP - World Bank)
data_source: ISRO SAC Desertification Atlas 2021 / NESAC Umiam
methodology: NESAC satellite radiometric and hydrological analysis

name: Manipur
primary_causes: Shifting cultivation on hill districts (Churachandpur, Senapati)
Encroachment and silt accumulation in Loktak Lake catchment area.
environmental_impact: Degradation of floating phumdis in Loktak Lake; soil nutrient depletion on ridge lands.
prevention_measures: Catchment protection planting; terraced rice cultivation; settled agroforestry.
active_schemes: National Mission for Sustaining the Himalayan Ecosystem
methodology: AWiFS optical multi-temporal mapping

name: Tripura
primary_causes: Intensive brick kiln topsoil excavation in valley floors
Rubber monoculture replacing diverse native tropical moist forests
Jhum cultivation on hill slopes.
environmental_impact: Loss of humus-rich top layer; reduced groundwater recharge in porous sedimentary hills.
prevention_measures: Agro-forestry with intercropping; systematic soil regeneration on abandoned brick fields; contour terracing.
active_schemes: Indo-German Development Cooperation Project on Climate Change Adaptation in Tripura
methodology: High-resolution satellite imagery

name: Arunachal Pradesh
primary_causes: Seismically active steep mountain slopes vulnerable to torrential downpours
Linear infrastructure cutting across sensitive geologies
Shifting cultivation in lower foothill valleys.
environmental_impact: Flash floods; riverbed sedimentation; temporary damming of mountain tributaries by landslides.
prevention_measures: Bio-turfing and hydroseeding on cut road slopes; community-based sacred grove conservation; sustainable cardamom agroforestry.
active_schemes: National Adaptation Fund for Climate Change (NAFCC)
methodology: Digital Elevation Model & multi-spectral remote sensing

name: Sikkim
primary_causes: High-energy Teesta river canyon runoff
Glacial lake expansion and moraine instability in North Sikkim.
environmental_impact: Landslide vulnerability along arterial roads; glacial lake outburst risk.
prevention_measures: Complete state-wide organic agriculture eliminating synthetic chemical inputs; Dhara Vikas spring rejuvenation; slope drainage chutes.
active_schemes: National Mission for Sustaining the Himalayan Ecosystem
methodology: Satellite cryospheric & optical multi-temporal mapping

name: Chhattisgarh
primary_causes: Extensive open-cast coal, iron, and bauxite mining in Korba, Dantewada, and Raigarh
Deforestation and forest fragmentation
Heavy runoff on degraded red and yellow lateritic soils.
environmental_impact: Loss of biodiverse Sal and teak canopy; water table pollution by heavy mining particulates.
prevention_measures: Compulsory compensatory afforestation; gully plugging using loose boulder structures; bio-fertilizer and compost promotion.
active_schemes: Suraji Gaon Yojana (Narwa, Garuwa, Ghurwa, Bari)
methodology: IRS AWiFS satellite classifications

name: Goa
primary_causes: Historical iron and manganese ore mine tailings along Zuari and Mandovi river basins
Coastal beach sand erosion due to sea wall construction and tourism footprints.
environmental_impact: Red mud wash into estuarine Khazan lands; siltation of mangrove creeks.
prevention_measures: Bio-stabilization of mine reject terraces with acacia and bamboo; revival of traditional Khazan dyke and sluice gate agriculture; coastal dune vegetation conservation.
methodology: Remote sensing coastal and estuarine monitoring

name: Kerala
severity: Low by Area, Critical in Extreme Rainfall Events
primary_causes: High-intensity monsoon downpours on steep modified slopes of the Western Ghats (Idukki, Wayanad)
Loss of natural wetlands (paddy puncha lands) to urban construction
Coastal wave erosion.
environmental_impact: Devastating debris flows and landslides; saltwater intrusion in Kuttanad below-sea-level farming system.
prevention_measures: Bio-terracing with Vetiver; conservation of Kuttanad below sea level heritage farming system; mangrove green wall restoration along coastal backwaters.
data_source: ISRO SAC Desertification Atlas 2021 / Kerala State Remote Sensing and Environment Centre (KSREC)
methodology: Multi-spectral satellite sensor data & high resolution topographic mapping

name: NCT of Delhi
primary_causes: Rapid urban sprawl replacing fertile Yamuna alluvium with concrete and asphalt
Over-extraction of groundwater causing soil subsidence
Encroachment on the ecologically vital Aravalli Ridge.
environmental_impact: Total loss of soil permeability and natural infiltration; urban heat island expansion; drying of city wetlands (Johads).
prevention_measures: Mandatory rainwater harvesting injection wells in all urban buildings; development of biodiversity parks (Yamuna and Aravalli Biodiversity Parks); permeable pavement construction.
methodology: High-resolution urban land use / land cover classification

name: Chandigarh
primary_causes: Urban footprint expansion
Soil siltation from degraded Shivalik hills into Sukhna Lake catchment.
environmental_impact: Siltation of Sukhna Lake; localized urban runoff surges.
prevention_measures: Catchment silt-retention dams in Sukhna Wildlife Sanctuary; strict urban green cover zoning.
methodology: High-resolution satellite mapping

name: Puducherry
primary_causes: Excessive pumping of groundwater in coastal aquifers leading to seawater intrusion
Disruption of longshore drift by harbour breakwaters.
environmental_impact: Salinization of agricultural wells; severe beach erosion requiring artificial reef nourishment.
prevention_measures: Submerged offshore reef construction; recharge shafts; micro-irrigation using treated wastewater.
methodology: Coastal remote sensing analysis

name: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
primary_causes: Coastal proximity and tidal ingress in Daman and Diu
High industrial development density in Dadra & Nagar Haveli.
environmental_impact: Salinization of low-lying soils; industrial chemical runoff vulnerability.
prevention_measures: Mangrove restoration on tidal mudflats; industrial effluent monitoring; coastal bunding.
methodology: IRS AWiFS satellite classifications

name: Lakshadweep
primary_causes: Coral reef degradation weakening wave buffering
Very thin freshwater lens resting on seawater, easily depleted by motorized pumps.
environmental_impact: Loss of narrow atoll landmass; salinization of coconut root zones and drinking water wells.
prevention_measures: Bio-rock reef restoration; rainwater harvesting covering 100% of residential roofs; ban on coral mining.
active_schemes: Lakshadweep Desalination and Water Security Project
data_source: ISRO SAC Desertification Atlas 2021 / National Centre for Sustainable Coastal Management (NCSCM)
methodology: Very high resolution optical satellite mapping

name: Andaman & Nicobar Islands
primary_causes: Coseismic tectonic subsidence following 2004 megathrust earthquake submerging coastal land under high tides
Torrential tropical rainfall eroding cleared undulating slopes.
environmental_impact: Permanent salt-killing of coastal mangrove belts and agricultural paddy lowlands; coral siltation.
prevention_measures: Mangrove regeneration in inundated tidal zones; multi-tier coconut-spices agroforestry; contour bunding.
methodology: Multi-spectral satellite mapping & coastal hydrographic surveys
